question.problem:
$$
[\begin{aligned}a & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & b & -2 \\ c & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

The matrix of the bilinear form $B(x,y)=3{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+{x}_{1}{y}_{2}-5{x}_{2}{y}_{2}-2{x}_{2}{y}_{3}-2{x}_{3}{y}_{1}$ is given above. What is the value of $a+b-c?$
question.worked_solution:
Each term ${a}_{ij}{x}_{i}{y}_{j}$ in the expression of the bilinear form corresponds to the entry ${a}_{ij}$ of the matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned}B(x,y) & =3{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+{x}_{1}{y}_{2}-5{x}_{2}{y}_{2}-2{x}_{2}{y}_{3}-2{x}_{3}{y}_{1} \\  & =3{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+1{x}_{1}{y}_{2}+0{x}_{1}{y}_{3} \\  & +\,0{x}_{2}{y}_{1}+(-5){x}_{2}{y}_{2}+(-2){x}_{2}{y}_{3} \\  & +\,(-2){x}_{3}{y}_{1}+0{x}_{3}{y}_{2}+0{x}_{3}{y}_{3}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, the corresponding matrix of the bilinear form is

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -5 & -2 \\ -2 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=3,$ $b=-5,$ and $c=-2.$ Finally, 

$$
a+b-c=3+(-5)-(-2)=0.
$$
